card.name: Drug interference with lab test results
card.fires_on: The word naming a lab test or its result (measurement, assay, levels, values, readings) right after a lab analyte, in drug-lab interference statements.

modes.label: Assay or measurement word
modes.description: Noun or word part for the test itself after a drug is said to interfere with it.
